raw_segments.text: Sarah did, as she was told. When the packages were unfolded, Miss Minchin's countenance
wore suddenly a singular expression. What she saw was pretty and comfortable clothing
clothing of different kinds—shoes, stockings and gloves, and a warm and beautiful coat.
There were even a nice hat and an umbrella. They were all good and expensive things, and
on the pocket of the coat was pinned to paper, on which were written these words,
to be worn every day, will be replaced by others when necessary.
